intros.text: Greetings! I am a great warrior from the Southern Kingdom. I have come here on a quest for honor. After my quest, I will have items I don't need, and I can give you {amount}× {ingredient}. Would you be interested in giving me something in kind?

Hey, you. I am an archer in the Northern Republic. I was sent here by my commander on a secret mission. After my job, I won't need some items, so I can give you {amount}× {ingredient}. However, what's in it for me?

Hello, cursed one. I am a mighty witch from the bog swamps to the west. I am going to fight the enemies to our north and south to protect my coven. I don't need {amount}× {ingredient}, though, and can give them to you if you help me.

outros.text: I need a short, blunt weapon on my quest, for I prefer close combat.
I want a long, blunt weapon like a club. My enemies need to be far but not too far.
I want a strong, metal item that can withstand pressure. I will need it for climbing... and fighting.
A small knife never hurt anyone, except those on its wrong end. That will do nicely.
I need a shield I can rely on. It must be large and imposing.
I forgot my food bowl. I know, it sounds stupid, but my journey is long and I need something to eat out of.
I need a small buckler or any similar metal shield that can help me move without restriction.
I will get into a serious fight, and I need an actual weapon. Something with spikes.
My mother's slipper is the deadliest weapon I ever knew. Do you have one?
I need a large container to put stuff in. Definitely not someone.
I am going to need something that can hold small things down, like a fork. I will probably stab things I shouldn't.
I need a shield, adequate. Not too big and not too small. Perfectly adequate.
I need a chair. No, wait, not a chair, just its back. You know, the part you rest your back on. Yes, I need it. NOW!
My boots have holes in them and I need replacements. Do you have a free pair?
I need something that I can break on someone's head and they will get knocked out, like ones in those cool theater plays!

hints.text: I have no specialty, but if you can get me a fancy looking item, I would be extra grateful.
I LOVE fire. Can you imagine everything hot and burning! I can! It is awesome!
I'm a chill person. I prefer the cold of ice to the warmth of... well, anything, really.
I am an artisan at heart, forced into this conflict. If something has that soul in it, I am happy.
I am not really precise with my weapons. So long as I hit someone, however, the poison does the job. That's what I like.
I need it to be sharp. Like me. My mind. Sharp. Everything has to be sharp to survive in this land.
